questions.title: Recursive Sum from 1 to N

Recursive Sum from 1 to N</text><text x="42" y="105" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Write recursive_sum(n) without loops or sum().</text><text x="42" y="143" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Return 1 + 2 + ... + n. For n = 0, return 0.</text><text x="42" y="181" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Example: recursive_sum(5) → 15</text><text x="42" y="219" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Example: recursive_sum(0) → 0</text><text x="42" y="257" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Target: O(n) time and O(n) call-stack space.</text><rect x="35" y="330" width="750" height="40" rx="10" fill="#eaf6ff"/><text x="55" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#075985">Solve recursively. Identify the base case first.</text></svg>
